title: 皐月賞の後に・二代の雪辱

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright manages to win the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Triple Crown. She's elated to have won and overwrite a bitter memory for Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While touched to learn the reason behind the victory, Mejiro Ryan voices her preference that Mejiro Bright run for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She explains the reason she lost that race was because of the weight of the Mejiro family's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright smiles at the thought of running for her own sake. With that, we set our sights on the Japanese Derby.
